dedupe_keys.name: ghana highway authority national road network trunk route list with lengths

description: The Ghana Highway Authority, which plans, builds and maintains Ghana's trunk road network under the Ministry of Roads and Highways, lists the national routes on its road network page. The page read on 2026-09-28 gives a table of the national (N) trunk routes with their end points and lengths in kilometres and miles, for example N1 Elubo to Tema (540 km), N6 Accra to Kumasi (250 km), N10 Kumasi to Paga (610 km) and N12 Elubo to Hamile (670 km); the site also has project, downloads and tender sections, such as the JICA-funded new Volta River bridge on the Eastern Corridor. Coverage is the national trunk network of Ghana at route level. Access is a free HTML table; no licence is named and no geometry, condition or traffic data are offered on this page, although the round 1 lead suggested condition data. Caveats: the table gives lengths only, regional and inter-regional routes are not detailed here, and figures are rounded. It supports building or checking a national road network model for network flow and capacity planning, and linking route identifiers to OpenStreetMap geometry for hazard exposure studies. It complements global road datasets that cover the geometry; no other Ghana road network record is catalogued.
